messages:
anya: Quick review: threshold control for Error Budget alerts 10-min standup. Current mock uses a single range slider with inline numeric input. Thoughts on discoverability and precision? kevin: Range slider is great for quick exploration but PMs want exact values saved. The inline numeric helps but is tiny on mobile. jules: Agree. Suggest a "snap-to" mode: slider for coarse, tap number to edit for fine-grain. Also add a unit selector (percent vs absolute errors) near the input. anya: Unit selector is important. People were confused last week when 0.5 meant 50% in some flows. We should make units explicit and persistent in the URL state. product: From product POV add "Estimated alerts/week" in the preview so users can see econ impact. Keep a small ephemerial tooltip explaining the guess. kevin: We can compute estimate from recent traffic + threshold. UI question: where to show it? Under the slider or in the preview panel? jules: Inline under the control feels immediate, but preview panel keeps the control area cleaner. Maybe show a condensed metric under slider and expand details in the preview. anya: Accessibility: range input should announce live changes when adjusted via keyboard. Use an aria-live region that updates with the formatted value and unit. Example: ```
Threshold set to 95%
``` Also ensure numeric input has step and pattern attributes for mobile keyboards. kevin: Good call. Also keyboard users should be able to nudge with arrow keys and page up/down for larger steps. We need e2e tests to verify. jules: Copy nit: current label "Threshold" is ambiguous. Propose "Alert threshold (percentage of failed requests)" or shorter: "Failure rate threshold". Which do you prefer? product: Prefer "Failure rate threshold". Short and clear. In the preview we can expand to more context: "Triggers when failure rate > X over Y minutes". anya: Suppression note: if suppression window overlaps the evaluation window, we should show a warning in the preview: "Suppression overlaps evaluation window; alerts may be delayed." Small red icon next to estimate. kevin: UI behavior: when user toggles unit from % to absolute, convert value sensibly and show a snackbar: "Converted 5% to 12 errors/min based on current traffic." Let users undo. jules: For mobile, numeric input should expand to full width when focused so users can type easily. Also enlarge the touch target for the unit toggle. aria-bot: deploy-preview: https://staging.redwood.com/alerting/threshold-controls-1765558888 includes aria-live updates and conversion snackbar :robot_face: anya: I'll run a quick a11y pass on the build and test keyboard nudging. If anything pops, I9ll add comments. Thanks all.
